scope: Independent experimental-design advice; no GPU or model forward. Source-family split, legal clearance and exact sample counts must be frozen by coordinator before inference.

budget.prices: Indicative previous live rates; actual reservation_guard must recompute before each attempt

primary_model.learning_rate_reason: Hold the published original candidate setting constant; the previous controlled 3e-5 trial did not win. This is not an optimal-LR claim.

primary_comparison.comparison: Frozen matched v4 data protocol + training schedule against paired unadapted 2B base at identical preprocessing and generation settings
primary_comparison.causal_limit: Changing data language, task mixture, diversity and total supervised exposure together tests the recipe, not one isolated root cause. Optional one-factor developer experiments must stay separately labelled.
primary_comparison.new_holdout: Family/image/document/conversation split fixed before any model output; separately report untrained source/condition transfer. No pretrained-corpus decontamination guarantee.

data_targets.multi_turn_method: Each assistant turn may become a row, with previous turns in context and only final assistant supervised; all derived turns remain the same family/split.

training_candidates.updates_formula: ceil(record_count * epoch_count / gradient_accumulation), bounded by runner and measured runtime; actual final row visits can round at the last update
training_candidates.timeouts: Measure actual maximum image/history row and throughput; soft update cap is not whole-container wall time.

proposed_selection_rule.status: Do not retroactively apply after viewing new outputs; finalize and commit first.

deliverables: source registry with fixed pins and reuse rights
all-row encoding and target/EOS mask audit
rubric and validation selection rule commit

priorities.purpose: Same-model small development-set pixel comparison only if CPU inspection indicates resized text becomes unreadable; otherwise just largest-row fit and paired base validation baseline.

priorities.candidate: fresh 2B LoRA; checkpoints near complete first and second epoch if archival implemented
preserve: actual peak allocated/reserved and container resource limitations

priorities.review: Independent full raw-output semantic/image-grounded review; exact OCR/CER and normal stopping separate
priorities.asr: one actual transcription reused across model variants; typed gold is separate control

choose_one: 2B resumed second epoch if not archived
4B base and matched-data adapter only if developer evidence indicates residual capacity gap
different frozen ASR only if typed chat improved but ASR is demonstrable bottleneck
priorities.condition: Actual live ledger still reserves final test and release; do not mix several factors into one claimed root cause.

deliverables: exact adapter and raw validation-result SHA

priorities.new_holdout: one completed paired base/selected run, no re-selection
priorities.known_regression: predeclared v3 cases remain separately labelled and scored, never described as unseen
outputs: ASR errors, typed-chat and speech-chat separated

priorities.release: inference-only allowlist, actual anonymous byte/SHA roundtrip, no original-data redistribution unless explicitly permitted
priorities.chapter: continuous rewritten explanation based on actual final result; historical troubleshooting in evidence only
priorities.reviews: fresh readability then corrected factual then corrected continuity; source/figure hash-matched reading-time refresh after content freezes

api_findings.qwen3vl_processor_image_class: AutoImageProcessor / Qwen2VLImageProcessor, not a standalone Qwen3VLImageProcessor

existing_runner_changes_needed: accept new committed v4 manifest/selection namespace without weakening exact-byte checks
make LR explicitly configurable rather than hardcoded 3e-5
fresh adapter for new manifest; strict resume remains for same manifest
archive predeclared checkpoint candidates or use two serial train/validation stages
allow final output buckets distinguishing new holdout from known regressions
preserve original durable ledger and credential isolation
no_claims: new data found or legally cleared by this research agent
general OCR or arbitrary-voice reliability achieved
